decisions.reason: As a very recently launched product the firm is likely to continue with it for now, but the weaker website commitment—only a mention rather than a dedicated page—makes it somewhat easier to withdraw than the others.

The dedicated product page signals visible commitment and investment, and a large established German electrical equipment maker would typically give a new medical lighting product more time before abandoning it.
This product sits close to the firm's industrial electrical core and was given its own page, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both make near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The product was not only given its own page but publicly presented as a relaunch of a popular designer task light, which raises reputational commitment and makes management likely to persist.
